description: This file defines the `SignatureProvider` class, which provides static methods for resolving, creating, and caching signature objects used for AWS request signing. It includes signature version handling, provider composition, and specific signature implementations for different AWS services and authentication schemes.

classes.name: SignatureProvider
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate, resolve, and cache signature objects for AWS service requests based on various signature versions.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns a signature object for given version, service, and region, throwing an exception if resolution fails.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Returns the default signature provider which is memoized.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a signature provider with caching to avoid recreating signature objects for the same inputs.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns a signature provider function that creates signature objects for known versions like v4, v4a, and anonymous.
